about_the_game:
Designated Driver Simulator: Become the True Hero of the Streets!

Designated Driver Simulator is an open-world game set in a bustling city where you take on the role of a designated driver. Meet diverse passengers, take them safely to their destinations, and earn money along the way! Your goal is to pay a set amount of money to your demanding boss each week. Fail, and your contract is terminated, ending the game. But if you succeed, greater upgrades and new opportunities await!

About the Game

🚗 An Adventure Through the City’s Nightlife
Navigate a sprawling open-world city and encounter a wide range of passengers. From impatient office workers to intoxicated artists, each customer presents unique demands that will test your judgment. Satisfy your passengers to earn more tips and rewards!

💰 Vehicle Upgrades & Customization
Spend your hard-earned cash to purchase new vehicles or upgrade your existing ride. Customizing your car’s appearance not only adds personality but also enhances performance for faster and safer drives!

📚 Sharpen Your Skills for Greater Success
Train at various academies throughout the city to improve your driving and communication skills. Masterful driving and excellent customer service are key to becoming the ultimate designated driver.

😡 Survive the Grueling Weekly Payments
Your relentless boss expects a set payment every week. The journey won’t be easy, but don’t lose hope. Only persistence and wisdom will lead you to success!

You can become the true hero of the streets. Start your journey in Designated Driver Simulator now!
